Yes to which?  End of Days or Hypersonic Assault?

Hypersonic Assault would mean a round without damage from Omnitron, but we'd still have to deal with all the drones afterwards.

End of Days means that we'd take Omnitron's damage, but all of the drones (and the Ongoings) go poof...but it also means that we spend a round biding our time, unable to get set up (and taking the damage from the Interpolation Beam every time we draw).
